Name: Kuri's Plantable Farm Cave
Author: Kurimiu
Description:
[i][color=#9fc5e8][size=2][b]Sorry for any awkward phrasing — I relied on machine translation since English isn't my strong suit T_T

[/b][/size][/color][/i][size=3][b] 🍇[/b][/size] Expanded the cave's layout, adds plantable areas, introduces vibrant vegetation to create a brighter atmosphere.
[size=3]
[list]
[*]Evergreen greenhouse cave
[*]Winemaking functionality
[*]Minecart
[/list][/size]　⚠ 
[list]
[*][size=3] Conflicts with farm maps that modify the cave (Choose only one to avoid issues）[/size]
[*][size=3]The small pond cannot be fished, but provides water[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size]
扩展了洞穴的大小，添加了种植区域，可种果树，并且添加了花草让洞穴色彩更明亮一些

[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=2]🍇特点[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]可以放置小桶[/size]
[*][size=3]帐篷里有两个3x3种植区[/size]
[*][size=3]四季温室的作用，草地不会因为季节改变[/size]
[/list]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=2]🍇注意[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]如果使用带改变洞穴的农场地图会引起冲突，解决办法就是只选择一个洞穴替换地图[/size]
[*][size=3]不可钓鱼，但可以取水[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size]📸 Mods in screenshots:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage - Unofficial Update for 1.6
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interior[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30165]Peaches ReShade - An Aesthetic Preset（图上可能没显示但也十分推荐，会让水色变好看，并添加一点暖玫瑰色）
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]Better Crops and Foraging[/url]
[url=https://m.blog.naver.com/codnjsdl8235/222314151470]GH's Peach Tall Body type
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23340]sugarmaples' Cafe Clothes[/url]

[i]💬[/i]有任何问题请在评论中告诉我[i]💬[/i]

[i]（手机版和1.5改content.json中的Format到1.1~1.8区间内使用）[/i]
